description: Inputs to the certificate derivation that are not part of G5: Tandon's automorphism T and the eight exchanges of Appendix B.1, copied from arXiv:2608.30273 (eqs 149 and 152). A 10-dimensional word is an ordered pair of base-7 codes of 5-dimensional words (eq. 148).
tandon_script_output: Tandon's own script (verify_certificates.py, repository head c753408492dd) derives C1 = 27488, C2 = 12839823, C3 = 14045805, C4 = 841760069965664 (run by the orchestrator's triage, about 42 s); cited here for comparison only, never used.
